steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The three Punic Wars (264-146 BC) were fought between Rome and Carthage for control of the Western Mediterranean

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: First Punic War (264-241 BC): Rome built its first navy and won Sicily as its first province

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Second Punic War (218-201 BC): Hannibal crossed the Alps with elephants, won at Cannae (216 BC) but was eventually defeated by Scipio at Zama (202 BC)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Battle of Cannae was Rome's worst military defeat: perhaps 50,000-70,000 Romans died in a single day
